scope: Offline headless five-trial suite (tests/test_v6_suite.cjs, adaptive offline policy, seeds 42 and 1) after two fixes. No browser, CSP, real model or hardware. seed 42 and seed 1 are development/regression data.
fixes: src/pick-place.js: release-height evidence anchors the object on its visible edge when the endpoint disk hides a whole top/bottom edge (0.35 platform). The 2.5 px releaseHeightMatched tolerance is unchanged.
src/agent-core.js: offline adaptive policy reverses a probe that the device clamped to zero at a joint limit instead of repeating it.

rootCause.releaseHeight: Grasp snaps the object to the tip, so true tip-object offset equals the platform offset. At h=0.35 the object's bottom edge (tip+0.95 px) lies inside the 7.5 px endpoint disk, so the orange bounding-box centre shifted 2-3 px upward; tip, B and platform markers were unbiased (~0.5 px uniform pixel-centre offset). At h=0 the occlusion is symmetric and at h=0.65 the edge is clear.
rootCause.probeLoop: seed 1 trial 5 (exposed once trial 4 passed): elbow at its 2.85 rad limit; probe channel A +1 was clamped to applied 0, added no sample, and the policy chose the same probe until the 180-action limit.

otherOfflineTests: All 18 other offline Node/Python tests listed in docs/VALIDATION_STATUS.md passed on the same tree; seed 42 action counts are identical to the pre-fix run.
